ferramenta: image_gen integrada; geração individual de cada recurso
direcao_usuario: Mesmo acabamento mais definido das fachadas; evitar blocos grandes e pixelização
prompt_comum: ONE isolated environment prop for AlgoLand. Cozy detailed hand-painted fantasy farming RPG matching warm terracotta-roof timber houses. Orthographic elevated three-quarter view, tops and front visible, no isometric diamond. Clean clear contours and broad readable shapes, natural colors, no chunky pixelation or photo realism. High resolution source for 4x logical display. Entire single object centered with 8% transparent margin. True transparent background; no scenery, no ground patch or cast shadow beyond base, no text. Spring appearance; fixed base-center pivot.
